title: Tanzu za Fasihi (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains fasihi, tells simulizi (by mouth, no known author) from andishi (written, known author), names the tanzu and places a piece he presents.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a riddle and a methali.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

board.say: Hadithi ya Sungura iko upande gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child places five pieces on the tree and presents one.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Fasihi simulizi hupitishwa kwa njia gani?" Kwa nini "kwa maandishi" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Fasihi andishi hupitishwa kwa njia gani?" Kwa nini "kwa mdomo" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni tanzu ipi ya fasihi simulizi?" Kwa nini "barua rasmi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Methali ni tanzu ya fasihi simulizi.

misconceptions.ask: Methali iko chini ya utanzu gani?
